content: Several learner corpora have been compiled for English, such as the International Corpus of Learner English BIBREF0 . The importance of such resources has been increasingly recognized across a variety of research areas, from Second Language Acquisition to Natural Language Processing. Recently, we have seen substantial growth in this area and new corpora for languages other than English have appeared. For Romance languages, there are a several corpora and resources for French, Spanish BIBREF1 , and Italian BIBREF2 .
